_comment: Fixture authored from mgechev/skillgrade's documented semantics (README: eval.yaml tasks + graders; N trials per task; per-trial reward = weighted grader scores 0..1; threshold default 0.8; deterministic grader stdout {score, details, checks[]}). The upstream repo does not publish a frozen persisted-results schema, so this fixture IS the converter's compatibility contract — see docs/interop.md. Note skillgrade has NO baseline mode: the import carries an empty baseline aggregate and null comparison.
